title: ADR GIS Atlas
text:
Using linked administrative data to understand people, place, services, environment and health across Wales.
The ADR GIS Atlas brings together research, methods, interactive analyses and publications developed through spatial analysis of linked administrative data.




Research exploring inequalities in access to infrastructure and essential services.
Explore Access to Services
Current stories include:

Access to WiFi





Research examining the relationship between people, places and environmental conditions.
Explore Climate & Environment
Areas of interest include:

Environmental exposure
Climate vulnerability
Place-based inequalities





Research exploring health outcomes and inequalities through linked administrative data.
themes/population-health/index.qmd
Areas of interest include:

Health inequalities
Population wellbeing
Geographic variation in health outcomes








Access to reliable internet is increasingly essential for education, employment, healthcare and social participation.
This project investigates patterns of internet and WiFi access across communities and population groups.
themes/access-to-services/access-to-wifi.qmd





All projects are supported by transparent and reproducible analytical workflows.
Methods documentation includes:

Data sources
Geographic processing
Statistical methods
Reproducibility guidance

methods/index.qmd




Publications, reports, preprints and presentations associated with Atlas projects.
publications/index.qmd




Feedback, discussion and collaboration are welcomed.
The Atlas is intended as a living resource that brings together research outputs, exploratory analyses, methods and data stories in a single place.
